summary: v10.6 testing: validated new Gemini 3.1 Pro video endpoint /api/scanner/analyze-video (6 new tests added) + frontend NeriaCorp video upload UI + regression checks on home barrels (NavigationSections→navigation/, DragDropComponents→dragdrop/). 14/14 backend tests passing including video success path on real MP4 (3KB sample) generated via imageio-ffmpeg.
critical_code_review_comments: scanner_ai.py size_limit check happens AFTER the chunk has been appended to bytes_written; the file is still partially written to /tmp before HTTPException is raised. The finally block correctly cleans up via shutil.rmtree, so this is acceptable but could be optimized by checking Content-Length header upfront for early rejection.

The 413 path raises HTTPException inside the `with open(...)` block which is caught by the bare `except Exception` and re-wrapped as 500. Verified at runtime: the explicit `except HTTPException: raise` at line 420 correctly re-raises and we observed 413 in tests. ✅
VIDEO_AD_PROMPT_SUFFIX correctly forces visual_type='REPORT' and main_action='Publier l'annonce' via defaults — verified test_analyze_video_admin_success passes.
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/test_sample.mp4 (3KB, 2s blue color, libx264) via imageio-ffmpeg binary
